diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a moderate upward trend (a net rise of ~17% of its level). A moderate seasonal pattern is present. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (26 points, ~2% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.4), which favours a weighted combination.
